english.title: Young person permit child or young person to enter adult gaming centre premises - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a young person aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..), permitted a

(A)_[child]_
(B)_[young person]_

aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..) to enter premises where an adult gaming centre premises licence had effect in respect of the premises, and the premises were being used in reliance on that licence when the

(C)_[child]_
(D)_[young person]_

was permitted to enter
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 47(5) and 62(2)(b) of the Gambling Act 2005.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording applies to young persons, aged 16 or 17, only; for adults see the offence wording GA05081/H8260.
(ii) Section 45 of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that "child" means an individual who is less than 16 years old, and "young person" means an individual aged 16 or 17.
(iii)Section 63 of the Gambling Act 2005 provides the defence of reasonable belief about a person's age.
